behavior.name: 0x130019c8
behavior.description: A floating flame that spawns either bhvFlameLargeBurningOut or bhvBlueFlamesGroup upon landing. Vertical velocity is capped by sFlameFloatingYLimit based on the 'sFlame Type's parameter. Despawns after 900 frames.

field.name: Flame Type
field.description: Determines initial velocity, vertical velocity cap, and the object spawned upon landing.
